name: [Tempest King 👑 + Summer 🏖️] Anime Apocalypse
desc:
⚠️ [BETA RELEASE] — Expect frequent updates, new content & balance tweaks. Found a bug or got feedback? Join our community and help shape the game!

Welcome to Anime Apocalypse!
Anime Apocalypse is a fast-paced Anime dungeon hack-and-slash zombie game! Fight through zombie filled dungeons, obtain unique abilities, and play unique gamemodes!

Will you survive the Apocalypse?

⚔️ Hack-and-Slash Action
💥 Unique Anime Abilities
🏃 Unique Parkour Movement
🎯 Pets, Loadouts & More!

🎮 Controls
M1 — LMB / X / Square
Skill 1 — Z / L2 / LT
Skill 2 — X / L1 / LB
Skill 3 — C / R1 / RB
Skill 4 — V / R2 / RT
Gadget — E / D-Pad Up
Ultimate — G / D-Pad Down
Dash — Q / B / Circle
Slide — Ctrl / Y / Triangle
